description: Use this when the user wants Deepnia to make a voice-over reading the given text with a chosen voice: gets its exact price in Deepnia credits before anything is created. Nothing is charged. Show the price to the user; once they accept, call create_voiceover with the quote_id and credits it returns: that call makes the voice-over (a quote alone creates nothing).

language.description: The language to read in, where the model takes one (settings.languages in list_creation_options). Default: auto.

model.description: Voice-over model id. Default: Deepnia's default.

speed.description: Reading speed, where the model takes one (settings.speed). Default: 1.

stability.description: Voice stability, where the model takes one (settings.stability). Default: 0.5.

voice_id.description: Voice id from list_creation_options (type voiceover, same model).

name: quote_voiceover
title: Price a voice-over
